\section{What the analysis notices}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em]
  \item \finding{warning} \texttt{neighbor\_allgather/?} reports 0 messages but the fabric logged 16: the collective's own accounting disagrees with the traffic it produced.
  \item \finding{warning} \texttt{neighbor\_alltoall/?} reports 0 messages but the fabric logged 16: the collective's own accounting disagrees with the traffic it produced.
  \item \finding{note} Load imbalance is 1.64$\times$: the slowest rank was busy far longer than the mean.
  \item \finding{ok} 38 rank reattachment(s) occurred, up to incarnation 6: agent processes were replaced mid-run while the rank roles, their mailboxes, and their context accounts persisted.
  \item \finding{ok} All 11 checkable collective(s) sent exactly the number of messages their closed-form cost expression predicts.
\end{itemize}
